title: The Watcher
description: Cross the room. Don't let it see you move. Red-light-green-light with lasers.
body:
# The Watcher 👁

**Cross the room. Don't let it see you move.**

Use the **Arena Totem** and it builds a sealed arena, summons every player in
the dimension to the start line, and the game begins. At the far end, a giant
face fills the wall, with an iron door beneath it.

- ⚫ **Face dark:** run.
- 🟡 **Face glowing:** freeze. Anyone who moves is lasered. Instantly.
- Phases flip on random timers with beacon sound cues and action-bar warnings.
  When the eyes open you get a fraction of a second of mercy. A fraction.

First to the door wins — the door opens, and **everyone else still inside
meets the lasers**. Only the first one survives.

Works solo (practice) and multiplayer (betrayal).

## ⚠️ A word of caution

The totem summons *all* players in the dimension and the arena is carved
into whatever terrain you aim at. Choose your moment and your real estate
responsibly. There is no refund on either.

## 📦 Requirements

- Minecraft 26.1.2 (Java Edition)
- [Fabric Loader](https://fabricmc.net/use/installer/) + [Fabric API](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-api)

Required on both client and server.
